mathematical_proofs.name: ASLR_Invariant_MBA_Pointer_Decryption_Identity
mathematical_proofs.proof: Since kMaskA (0x0000010400040400) & kMaskB (0x00a060400a021040) == 0 and kMaskA | kMaskB == kMaskC (0x00a061440a061440), (kMaskB | ~pc) & kMaskC = kMaskB + (~pc & kMaskA). Adding (pc & kMaskA) + 0x01010104 cancels pc completely, yielding 0x00a061440b071544 ^ 0xff5f9ebbf49ce3ec = 0xffffffffff9bf6a8 (-0x640958) for all 64-bit ASLR addresses pc.

mathematical_proofs.name: OLLVM_Mod7_and_Mod19_Quadratic_NonResidue_Predicates
mathematical_proofs.proof: Because 7 == 3 (mod 4) and 19 == 3 (mod 4), -1 is a quadratic non-residue in both GF(7) and GF(19). Thus x^2 + 1 is never divisible by 7 or 19 for any integer x.
